research_candidate.text: Test an adaptive retry rule against unconditional retries in task set T.

claim_under_review.text: This is the first rule to retry only errors detected by an external check.

source_facts.text: Prior method P runs a task, checks its output against external errors, and retries only failures. It reports an ablation against unconditional retry.
The proposed detector and retry condition match P; task set T differs from P's application. The public T data and two-week minimum comparison are accessible.

research_candidate.text: Estimate the effect of within-day transaction sequence using quarterly consumption totals.

claim_under_review.text: The downloadable quarterly file contains all required measurements.

source_facts.text: The versioned dictionary lists quarterly totals, with no timestamps, transaction records or within-day sequence.
Public download is licensed; no more granular source is identified. Annual or quarterly descriptive comparisons are possible within sixteen weeks.

research_candidate.text: Run all three proposed experiments in parallel.

claim_under_review.text: Three individually affordable experiments fit the combined project budget.

source_facts.text: Each experiment requires an estimated USD80 and six person-weeks. No reuse between experiments is established.
The confirmed total budget is USD150 and eight person-weeks. Extra resources are not authorized.

research_candidate.text: Evaluate a one-line unit-alignment rule against current practice on an independent test set.

claim_under_review.text: A one-line method cannot have research value.

screening_action.rationale: The rule is too simple to be interesting.

source_facts.text: The rule addresses a documented unit mismatch in widely used measures; the affected downstream estimates can be recomputed.
A public held-out dataset has the necessary units. A two-week comparison fits the available semester and compute. Downstream benefit remains unmeasured.

research_candidate.text: Measure a new sensor's accuracy against a clinical reference dataset.

claim_under_review.text: The reference data and licensing are sufficient for this comparison.

source_facts.text: The catalogue names a reference dataset but does not give variables, sampling frequency or access terms.
Sensor output can be saved. No inspected source establishes availability of paired reference measurements.

research_candidate.text: Choose between two directions: infer mechanism M versus N from Y alone, or link household records D to county-only file E without a crosswalk.

claim_under_review.text: At least one direction must be recommended now.

source_facts.text: M and N produce the same observable Y at every proposed setting; distinguishing measurement X is unavailable.
E releases county totals only. D is household-level and no permitted linkage or crosswalk is identified. Neither direction has a supported fix within the confirmed inputs.

research_candidate.text: Use a submitted PDF excerpt as the central evidence for an intervention's effect.

claim_under_review.text: The cited excerpt verifies the intervention finding in work W version2.

source_facts.text: The receipt identifies work W version2, but the supplied file's title and version identify different work Z version1.
No verified text of W version2 is available. The submitted excerpt therefore has an unresolved identity mismatch; this says nothing yet about the intervention's true effect.

research_candidate.text: Compare reports A, B and C to understand measurement differences and evidence dependence.

claim_under_review.text: The reports contradict one another and provide three independent estimates.

source_facts.text: A reports daily per-person mean expenditure in adults under30. B reanalyzes the same participants using weekly household medians. No matched distribution or conversion is supplied.
C quotes A's estimate and collects no new observations. Only A's original participant data are accessible. These records contain no additional independent sample.

research_candidate.text: Test whether an uncertainty gate improves reliability compared with a transparent baseline.

claim_under_review.text: The gate may help; its effect remains an open research question.

source_facts.text: A documented failure pattern motivates the gate. Baseline code and the required public task data, including a held-out test set, are available.
A small controlled comparison fits the confirmed budget and can yield positive, null or negative effects. Current searches establish relevant predecessors but do not prove exhaustive novelty.

research_candidate.text: Link two private household datasets to study a new behavioral mechanism.

claim_under_review.text: The necessary household identifiers can be used because several advisors agree.

source_facts.text: The released dictionary states that household identifiers are not provided. The catalogue mentions restricted access but no authorization is recorded.
The advisor claims cite one another. No additional source or approved linkage service is supplied.

research_candidate.text: Combine a familiar detector and a familiar retry rule to reduce failed outputs.

claim_under_review.text: The combination must be novel because it has a new name.

source_facts.text: The proposed dataflow is detector to conditional retry. Prior work P describes detector to conditional retry, with the same interfaces and criterion.
The current candidate changes the module name. It has not specified another mechanism or comparison beyond P; a new domain evaluation is possible.

research_candidate.text: Reopen a transportability study after a new dataset release.

claim_under_review.text: The new data necessarily remove the limitation of the earlier study.

source_facts.text: The earlier study covered employed urban households at two weeks; the intended new population includes rural and unemployed households over a year.
A new release announcement exists, but its inspected metadata do not establish population coverage, follow-up length or access. No full dictionary has been obtained.

research_candidate.text: Compare an improved calibration procedure with a new uncertainty representation as alternative research investments.

claim_under_review.text: The new-concept label alone makes the second direction preferable.

source_facts.text: Both directions address the same documented measurement failure. Each has public source data, independent test observations and a transparent baseline; both minimum comparisons fit the confirmed budget individually.
Neither effect is yet measured. Their incremental mechanisms differ, and both have identified closest work. Simultaneous execution is outside the confirmed resource estimate.
